data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR baggage is an add-on model: base fares include two cabin items weighing 7 kg combined, every checked piece is charged by route, airport purchase adds a processing fee, and each checked piece must be 30 kg or less and no larger than 203 cm total dimensions.

fees.conditions: Two cabin items share a 7 kg limit. Buy 8 kg more at least 24 hours before departure for a 15 kg maximum; airport purchase unavailable.

data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR’s base fare includes 7 kg carry-on only. Flex Biz and similar packages can include extra carry-on weight and seat selection on eligible routes.

fees.conditions: Every piece is charged by route, including the first. Each may weigh up to 30 kg and measure up to 203 cm total; five-piece maximum.
fees.timing: at booking / manage booking / at airport

data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR’s tariff lists paid ancillary services; checked baggage is accepted when a paid ancillary or fare rule allows it.

fees.conditions: Repack every piece to 30 kg or less. An unpurchased airport bag incurs the route checked-bag price plus a processing fee.

data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR does not publish an overweight surcharge band above its 30 kg per-piece limit. The practical remedy is another paid piece, not paying to make one bag heavier.

fees.conditions: Checked baggage over 203 cm total dimensions or 30 kg is not accepted as ordinary checked baggage

data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR's conditions of carriage state checked baggage above 203 cm total dimensions or 30 kg is not accepted.

fees.conditions: Sports equipment is an optional paid service by item/route and remains subject to checked-bag acceptance limits

data_quality.notes: Sports equipment is not a blanket free item; it follows ZIPAIR's optional-service pricing and checked-bag acceptance limits.

fees.conditions: Seat selection is paid unless included in an eligible package such as Flex Biz; prices vary by route and seat type

data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR sells seat selection as an optional service, while Flex Biz-style packages can bundle it with extra carry-on allowance and cancellation flexibility.

fees.conditions: Standard fares are generally non-refundable; Flex Biz can return value as a voucher based on cancellation timing

data_quality.notes: Flex Biz changes the cancellation answer but does not create a simple cash-refund rule; voucher amount depends on timing and fees.

fees.conditions: U6 fares give children under 6, including infants under 2, their own seat; stroller handling is outside normal bag pricing
fees.applies_to: Children under 6 and passengers traveling with eligible child-care items

data_quality.notes: ZIPAIR's U6 model is unusual for an LCC because children under 6, including infants under 2, are assigned seats rather than treated as lap infants.
